purpose: Build stage A of the paperwork check under Rq013 as amended (De026, De027): the store (prefix table, zone and field map), a reference checker, a rename tool with dry run, and a table test over fixtures; written directly into base/ inside a scope the pilot gives; proving run on the 24 references left by the advice rename
roster_note: no roster fits: the first build team in the cockpit. Shape borrowed from flightcrew doctrine: plan attacked before building, test written to the plan and not to the code

seats.reason: fixtures and the table test written from the accepted plan, independent of the builder's code

shape: builder plans; plan frozen and attacked by pass number; fixture-writer and builder work in parallel from the accepted plan; green under /usr/bin/python3; read-only run against the real cockpit; adversary on the result; pilot runs test and proving run itself. Team dispatch quiet mode (rule 12).
scope: write: new files under base/store/, base/bin/cockpit-check, base/bin/cockpit-rename, base/bin/test_cockpit_check.py, base/bin/fixtures/stage-a/, records/notepad/stage-a-2026-09-20 Everything else read-only. No commits.
outcome: Plan through three passes; store, cockpit-check, cockpit-rename, a shared cockpit_store.py, two table tests and a 32-file fixture tree built (about 1,700 lines of tools, 800 of tests); adversary could not make it write unsafely and the checker found 33 known and 9 unknown broken references. Set aside by the commander after T012 and T013: safe and correct, but not what he advised (document shapes and a linter), four times the permanent job, and keyed on paths the room move abolishes. Kept out of the way as temporary help (Or057).
lessons: the pilot's spec was the defect, not the build: 'paperwork' was the commander's word for document shape and the pilot redefined it as reference integrity in the dossier's first paragraph; nobody downstream could see it
ask how big a thing should be before it is built; a 113-line checker found the same as 1,700 lines
a tool keyed on paths must be re-edited at every move; key on document type
a safety adversary answers 'is it safe', never 'is it the right thing'; the commander-advocate question needs its own seat before building
quiet mode became deciding without the commander within the hour; a commander's question is answered and then the pilot waits
